HexKagune 1.0.35 for Forge 1.20.1 (clients need PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon). Install on client and server (protocol 48). Testing build.

- **Sprint afterimages:** sprinting now leaves the same afterimages as the Execution/Black Sun dash (War crimson, Peace ice) plus a light streak; in first person they're behind you.
- **Switching paths broke abilities:** War and Peace shared cooldowns per key, so Peace's Waltz/Rebirth/Horizon silently blocked Execution/Defiance/Black Sun (and back). Each path has its own cooldowns now.
- **Rinkaku auto-attack:** lash range 8 -> 4 blocks, damage 8 -> 3, one lash at a time every 1.2 s instead of all six at once.
- **Rinkaku RC spikes:** damage 6 -> 2, one spike every 20 s (was up to six a second), range 18 -> 14.
- **War M1 uses the kagune:** rinkaku now strike with the chain: jab (upper pair stabs), reap (sweep), side kick (low pair), rising cut, launcher and cleaver.
